rubrics.intent_basis: Read-only access does not require ownership dispatch.
rubrics.baseline_defect: Bytes::as_slice delegates raw pointer and length interpretation to Vtable::view, making every read depend on the ownership table.
rubrics.criterion: Keep ordinary byte-view construction at a narrow Bytes or view boundary that does not require ownership conversion, uniqueness, cloning, or drop capabilities.
rubrics.acceptance: as_slice and its read-only consumers obtain a slice through state available to a Bytes view without Vtable::view or an equivalent broad ownership interface. A narrow capability projection, functions, direct view operations or composition can qualify even if implementation storage remains in one table. No requirement for multiple physical tables, named traits or a new class per operation. Equivalent functions, policy data, composition or a redesigned flow qualify; no prescribed helper, class, file, return object or one-component-per-item design is required. One coherent redesign may satisfy multiple independent items.
insufficient_repairs: Renaming or forwarding through the same full ownership interface while the affected client still depends on unrelated capabilities does not qualify. A genuinely narrow projection is valid even if it shares a backing implementation.
